reasoning: This is an abstract UI tool glyph (Material 'blur_on' / pixelate / marquee intersection) consisting of a square outline dissolving into small squares at the top-left corner. Outside of an image-editing toolbar, a user scanning a to-do list will not reliably recognize what real-world subject it represents, making it unsuitable as a glanceable task icon.
